Subject : Catchin some sun in my free flowin

Body
Hi [Bffs nickname],
You remember those times when the world seemed a bit slower in high summer & we had hours to la la loit around, I'm thinking those times could be making something of return. So much so in fact i might just be on day six straight. You see i started getting more serious with photography over a couple years. But i just bought myself an SLT camera last month that i can now play more handsy (literature reference in that one! :)) & shoot without being too fiddily.
It all came together today - a beautiful, cloudless Sunday and I had a spare couple h's. Decisvely, the only person in this world who knows the best locations for sunrizes (aside maybe the sun) and is always on hand to join, has a very very patient and lovely partner, so naturally the plan to hit up that spot at day's start came to pass. We set our watches 9:pm,
